layers.counts: every shot attempt the league recorded: on goal, missed, or blocked, because all three are the team moving the puck at the net
layers.credits: A blocked attempt is credited to the team that shot it — the shot was still taken, it just never arrived.
layers.label: ＋ Attempts

layers.counts: attempts from within 33 ft of the net, 22 ft either side of the middle, and in front of the goal line
layers.credits: Credited to the team that shot. Blocked attempts are excluded because the coordinate the feed records is where the puck stopped — so we know who shot it, but not from where.
layers.label: ＋ Shots from the slot

work.label: How many shot attempts are taken from the slot

layers.counts: the attempts a body stopped before they reached the goalie
layers.credits: Each block is credited to the team that made it, the way a broadcast does. A block by a teammate is credited to neither, so the two figures need not add up.
layers.label: ＋ Blocked shots

layers.counts: every shot each goaltender faced, and what became of it — saved, scored on, or missed the net
layers.credits: Each goaltender is counted for the team he plays for, against the other team’s shots — so these two columns read the opposite way round.
layers.label: ＋ Goaltending

work.label: How often a goaltender makes the save

layers.counts: the rule that stopped play, and the dot it restarted on
layers.credits: A stoppage names a rule and never a team, so nothing here is credited to either side.
layers.label: ＋ Why play stopped

work.label: How many penalties a team takes
How often a team is offside
How often a team ices the puck

layers.counts: every face-off, and for the team that won it, whether that face-off was in its offensive zone, the neutral zone, or its defensive zone
layers.credits: Each face-off is credited to the team that won it, in the zone that team was attacking toward — so the same dot is an offensive-zone start for one team and a defensive-zone start for the other.
layers.label: ＋ Zone starts

work.label: What a face-off in one end is worth

layers.counts: every shot attempt a defenceman took — on goal, missed, or blocked — out of all of a team’s attempts
layers.credits: Each attempt is credited to the team that shot it, and counted here when the shooter is listed as a defenceman.
layers.label: ＋ Who shoots

work.label: How many shot attempts defencemen take

layers.counts: every face-off, credited to the team whose player won it
layers.credits: Each face-off is credited to the team that won it; both players who took it are named.
layers.label: ＋ Face-offs

work.label: Who takes the shots after a face-off
